name: Iriya Kamori
source:
The sole survivor of her household after the Koushin Disaster strikes, she is saved by Nao together with Yachiru.

Gregarious and high-spirited, she keeps the survivors' spirits high no matter how tough it gets in the town ruins. She frequently teases Yachiru and frequently asks Nao and Sachi about the nature of their relationship.

When the survivors reach New Akatsuki town, Kamori is the most adaptable and attempts to recreate the life she had before the Disaster as best as she can. She's extremely fond of convenience store junk food but is cautious of her calorie intake. 

Kamori doesn't manifest her Baroque powers until she reaches New Akatsuki town. She can spontaneously generate fire and quickly learns to use it for both offence and defence. The raw power of her fireballs is enough to melt steel at 1500 degrees Celsius. 

[Spoiler] Despite her cheerful disposition, she is actually suffering from PTSD and survivor's guilt which she tries to forget by living her live in the present to the maximum. Tonosaka exploits her vulnerable mental state in her route and implants a destructive split personality in her which periodically goes berserk and burns down much of the new town. When she's in her destructive mental state (which Tonosaka christens as "Carrie") she loses all memory of her actions when she returns to normal. Her powers are considerably more effective when she loses to "Carrie", strong enough to convince the American agents ordered to capture her to focus solely on killing her as they realise it's impossible to take her in alive. It is during her destructive rampage that she destroys Sachi's apartment, which is the trigger that leads to her death at Nao's hand. 

In her route ending, Nao is free to "visit" her as and when he pleases. Although she enjoys the food Nao picks for the pair of them, he can't always finish meals for two... [/Spoiler]
